title: Sevii Islands: One, Two & Three
subtitle: Meteorite delivery, Rock Smash, Moltres, save Lostelle

steps.text: One Island Pokémon Network Center: Bill introduces Celio. Bill hands you the Meteorite to deliver to the Game Corner owner on Two Island; Celio gives the Tri-Pass so the ferry runs between Islands One–Three.
Treasure Beach (south of One Island, Surf): eight hidden items in the sand, refreshing over time.
Kindle Road (north): long strip of trainers and a hot spring.
Ember Spa: the old man inside gives HM06 Rock Smash. It also heals your party.
Mt. Ember exterior: Rock Smash and Strength open the way up. Explosion tutor here (once). Two Rocket Grunts guard the Ruby path but it is closed until after the Elite Four.
Mt. Ember summit: Moltres Lv.50 (Fire/Flying, weak to Rock ×4). One-time; save, then Rock Slide/Surf and Ultra Balls.
Two Island: the Game Corner owner is too worried to take the Meteorite; his daughter Lostelle is missing on Three Island. The market stall sells rare items as you progress.
Cape Brink (north of Two Island): hidden items; the house has a tutor who teaches Frenzy Plant / Blast Burn / Hydro Cannon to a fully evolved starter with max friendship (post-game).
Three Island: Bikers harass the town. Beat the gang (four battles); a resident then gives a Full Restore.
Three Isle Path / Dunsparce Tunnel (Rock Smash): the man inside gives a Nugget; Dunsparce lives here.
Bond Bridge (west of Three Island): trainers over the water, Berry Forest at the end.
Berry Forest: 13 hidden berries (they regrow) plus items. Find Lostelle in the northwest corner.
A Hypno Lv.30 attacks Lostelle; one-time encounter (catchable). Then she gives an Iapapa Berry and goes home.
Back on Two Island: Lostelle's father takes the Meteorite and gives a Moon Stone.
Return to Celio on One Island, then take the ferry back to Vermilion (or Cinnabar) to continue the Kanto story.
